custom_compose_config_string:
services:
  solana-scanner-gatec:
    image: solana-scanner-gatec:gatec
    pull_policy: "never"
    command: ["node", "/app/dist/main.js"]
    restart: unless-stopped
    init: true
    read_only: true
    user: "10001:10001"
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    mem_limit: 512m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 200
    environment:
      MODE: "paper"
      PAPER_STARTING_SOL: "10"
      MAX_POSITION_SOL: "0.35"
      MAX_CONCURRENT_POSITIONS: "4"
      MAX_DAILY_LOSS_SOL: "0.5"
      MIN_LIQUIDITY_USD: "3000"
      MAX_LIQUIDITY_USD: "2000000"
      MIN_AGE_MINUTES: "3"
      MAX_AGE_MINUTES: "259200"
      MIN_PRICE_CHANGE_M5_PERCENT: "1.5"
      MIN_VOLUME_M5_USD: "1000"
      MIN_MOMENTUM_SCORE: "50"
      MIN_STOP_LOSS_PERCENT: "5"
      MAX_STOP_LOSS_PERCENT: "20"
      STOP_VOLATILITY_MULTIPLIER: "1.0"
      BREAKEVEN_TRIGGER_PERCENT: "8"
      MIN_PROFIT_FOR_CONTINUE_PERCENT: "2"
      POSITION_SCORE_DIVISOR: "80"
      LIQUIDITY_POSITION_FRACTION: "0.02"
      STOP_LOSS_PERCENT: "12"
      TAKE_PROFIT_PERCENT: "8"
      TRAILING_STOP_PERCENT: "5"
      MAX_HOLD_MINUTES: "15"
      SIMULATED_SLIPPAGE_BPS: "100"
      SIMULATED_FEE_BPS: "100"
      SCAN_INTERVAL_SECONDS: "5"
      MAX_CYCLES: "0"
      STRICT_RISK_MODE: "false"
      WHALE_WALLETS: ""
      MIN_WHALE_TX_SOL: "670"
      BIRDEYE_API_KEY: "#### REDACTED ####"
      TRITON_ENDPOINT_FILE: "/run/secrets/triton-endpoint"
      TRITON_TOKEN_FILE: "/run/secrets/triton-token"
      RPC_HTTP_ENDPOINT_FILE: "/run/secrets/rpc-http-endpoint"
      RPC_WS_ENDPOINT_FILE: "/run/secrets/rpc-ws-endpoint"
      DATA_DIR: "/data"
      DASHBOARD_ENABLED: "true"
      DASHBOARD_PORT: "3000"
    ports:
      - "192.168.1.234:3002:3000"
      - "100.79.221.55:3002:3000"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /mnt/fastdisk/ai/hermes/solana-paper-scanner/data-gatec
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: /mnt/fastdisk/ai/hermes/secrets/solana-paper-scanner/rpc-http-endpoint
        target: /run/secrets/rpc-http-endpoint
        read_only: true
      - type: bind
        source: /mnt/fastdisk/ai/hermes/secrets/solana-paper-scanner/rpc-ws-endpoint
        target: /run/secrets/rpc-ws-endpoint
        read_only: true
      - type: bind
        source: /mnt/fastdisk/ai/hermes/secrets/solana-paper-scanner/triton-endpoint
        target: /run/secrets/triton-endpoint
        read_only: true
      - type: bind
        source: /mnt/fastdisk/ai/hermes/secrets/solana-paper-scanner/triton-token
        target: /run/secrets/triton-token
        read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=32m,mode=1777
